channel.title: Social Media Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Social Media Today (socialmediatoday.com)

item.title: YouTube tests video highlights preview feature
item.description: The new system could replace thumbnails and provide viewers with more context before they click on recommended clips.

item.title: Human speech and presence help drive Reels engagement
item.description: Videos that include a person talking or that feature a highly visible person in the first three seconds have better retention, according to new data from Emplifi.

item.title: Instagram adds AI transition option for still image-based Stories
item.description: The platform’s new tool within the image gallery will allow users to generate moving displays that show up as videos.

item.title: Why social media marketers are switching to cloud phones in 2026
item.description: Physical devices can't scale. Here's how cloud phones are changing multi-account management.

item.title: Instagram allows users to rearrange carousel posts
item.description: The much-requested feature will let creators edit the order of their images and videos after publishing.

item.title: LinkedIn’s latest promotional campaign targets marketing professionals
item.description: The company’s newest creative rollout addresses vanity metrics over real business impact by telling users to “cut the bullspend.”

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg is creating an AI clone of himself
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reported that the Meta CEO is building an AI agent to help him do his job more effectively.

item.title: YouTube brings updated tools to its creator partnership program
item.description: The platform is merging creator and advertising elements into a single space to facilitate collaboration opportunities and streamline affiliate marketing.

item.title: YouTube adds Top Sports Podcast lineup for advertisers
item.description: The platform is helping brands reach its more than 1 billion podcast listeners and connect with audiences during and after games.

item.title: Google brings Gemini AI-powered tools to its marketing platform
item.description: New elements are designed to improve ad performance and engagement tracking, as well as assist in campaign setup.
